title: Very Good Quality
text: Very Good Quality. I love to decorate with tiered trays. Sometimes I have multiple trays set up, but usually it's just one. I change the themes monthly to coincide with seasons and holidays. These pieces are very good quality. The pieces look nice and not the flat, mass produced ones with paint that looks perfect. There is also a good assortment of items.  I am very pleased with these.
